## 2026-08-16 · the hermetic run agreed with me twice

I closed a round on a synthetic publisher and called it measured. The owner said: not on a live document. One hour of real slots found four things the fixture could not hold — and twice my first suspect was the operator's data when the defect was my own reader: prev from the wrong field, a root from the wrong tree. Tomorrow's me: a fixture answers the question you already framed. Live data brings the ones you didn't.
